artworks.title: Portrait of a Young Woman in Profile
artworks.medium: etching with monotype wiping on heavy wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image features a head-and-shoulders profile view of a person depicted with sketch-like lines and shading. The individual is shown in a right-facing position with head slightly bowed. The facial features are softly rendered with a subtle outline for the nose and lips, and the hair is short and tidy with texture added through delicate strokes. The person is wearing clothing that includes a garment with a collar, and the background is a textured surface with crosshatched lines and darker shading near the head. A signature is visible in the bottom right corner of the artwork.

artworks.title: Dairsie II
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
plate: 4 × 13.5 cm (1 9/16 × 5 5/16 in.)
sheet: 5.1 × 15.2 cm (2 × 6 in.) (irregular)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Vogler in memory of his brother Donald J. Vogler
artworks.description: The image is a landscape drawing depicting a scene from an elevated perspective. The composition includes a tree line, buildings, a church tower, and a large structure slightly above center. The fine brushstrokes capture detailed textures such as leaves, structures, and water flowing beneath a bridge. The drawing features a bridge crossing a waterway towards cottages surrounded by trees. The monochromatic palette emphasizes contrast and detail in the serene pastoral view.

artworks.title: A Concert of Birds
artworks.medium: mezzotint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Vogler in memory of his brother Donald J. Vogler
artworks.description: This is a drawing of various birds perched on branches. The drawing shows different bird species in intricate detail, with a large peacock on the left, surrounded by other birds including parrots, an owl, a toucan, and a heron. The birds are perched on a gnarled tree with branches, displaying dynamic poses. Some birds appear to be in flight, while others are settled on the branches. The background is a softly shaded sky, adding depth to the scene. The drawing has a monochromatic tone, emphasizing texture, form, light, and shadow.

artworks.title: Morning
artworks.medium: etching with engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Vogler in memory of his brother Donald J. Vogler
artworks.description: This is a painting of an early morning city scene. The image showcases a busy urban setting with rows of multi-story buildings surrounding an open space. People are gathered around a small fire in the open space. The setting suggests it is a cold morning. A woman dressed in elaborate attire is standing in the center. The architecture features classic European elements with stone facades. There is a prominent building on the right that houses a coffee shop, as indicated by visible signage. The style is reminiscent of William Hogarth, showcasing social contrasts during the 18th century.

artworks.title: Manerbawr Castle from the Inward Court
artworks.medium: etching with aquatint printed in brown on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Vogler in memory of his brother Donald J. Vogler
artworks.description: The image is an artistic depiction of a castle with detailed architectural features such as battlements, arched windows, and crumbling stone walls. Figures are portrayed engaged in an outdoor task near the castle, with carts and tools present. The castle stands tall with towers and wall structures in the background. The artistic style features detailed line work and gentle shading, creating texture and depth. The color palette is monochromatic with sepia tones, giving a historical and timeless feel. The sky above is softly rendered with subtle cloud formations.

artworks.title: Professor Joseph Lovering
artworks.medium: salted paper print
artworks.creditLine: Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a man seated in a chair. He is facing slightly left with a composed expression. The man has distinct features, including a broad forehead, styled hair, a beard under the chin, deep-set eyes, and a strong jawline. He is dressed formally in a dark jacket, high-collared shirt, and a cravat. The background is neutral, and the ornate backrest of the chair is visible.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man
artworks.medium: ambrotype with applied color
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a young man seated and displaying his upper body. He is positioned in a relaxed manner with one arm resting on a surface and the other on his knee. The young man has short black hair and a youthful expression with full lips and a focused gaze. He is dressed formally with a dark-colored vest and coat, light-colored shirt, and a bow tie. Two rings are visible on his fingers. The background is a plain, neutral tone with a frame featuring layered matting in gold and red hues.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man
artworks.medium: daguerreotype with applied color
artworks.creditLine: Alfred H. Moses and Fern M. Schad Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a person from the waist up. The individual is seated with one arm on a patterned table. They have light skin, an oval face, short dark hair, and are wearing a dark, wide-brimmed hat, a dark top with a bow or tie, and striped trousers. The setting is framed in a gold-colored border, giving it an antique look, and the background is blurred with soft tones.

artworks.title: Portrait of Two Men
artworks.medium: daguerreotype
artworks.creditLine: Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a historic photograph featuring two men. Both men are seated side by side, facing forward in a formal pose. They have distinct facial features. The man on the left has neatly combed, dark, parted hair. The man on the right has curly lighter hair. They are both wearing dark jackets, buttoned vests, high-collared shirts, and ties. The photograph is inside an ornate golden frame with intricate designs, housed within a wooden or dark material-bound case. The background is light-toned, typical of portraiture from this era. The mirrored effect shows the men's reflection or duplication along the horizontal axis.

artworks.title: Curio Shop
artworks.medium: albumen silver print with applied color
artworks.creditLine: Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund
artworks.description: The image shows two men seated among decorative objects in an interior space filled with shelves and display cases holding various items. The color scheme is primarily sepia-toned, giving a vintage look to the photograph. One man is seated on the left, partially turned to the side, while the other man is seated on the right next to shelves crowded with items. A variety of decorative objects are neatly organized on the shelves and platforms, with additional items placed on the ground.

artworks.title: Don Quixote in his Study
artworks.medium: photogravure
artworks.creditLine: Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated in an ornate, high-backed chair. His whole upper body, as well as his legs down to the knees, is visible. His left elbow rests on the arm of the chair, with his hand propping up his head. He has long hair and a full beard. He is wearing a light-colored shirt and darker, knee-length trousers and socks, with shoes that appear to be of the same shade. In his right hand, he holds a large, thick book, resting against his leg. Surrounding him are various objects, including weapons, armor elements, books, and scrolls placed on a table to his left. The background has a dark curtain partially pulled up and books stacked on the table.

artworks.title: Street Refreshment Stalls
artworks.medium: albumen silver print with applied color
artworks.creditLine: Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund
artworks.description: The image shows six people around a small outdoor stand. On the far left, a person carries a bundle on their shoulder. Next to them, a child peeks over the stand, sitting behind a counter. A man stands behind the counter, while two women and another man stand nearby. In the background, there is a wooden structure with vertically placed planks and a bamboo screen hanging above. Objects are placed on the stand.

artworks.title: American Falls from Luna Island
artworks.medium: glass transparency
artworks.creditLine: Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a frozen waterfall seen from a slightly elevated viewpoint. The wooden-framed scene showcases cascading icicles and frozen formations in the foreground, with a row of barren trees and some buildings visible against a pale sky in the background. The color palette is muted and monochromatic, primarily white, gray, and black, capturing the cold winter landscape. The differing textures of the smooth water's surface and rough icicles are notable.

artworks.title: Wells Cathedral
artworks.medium: albumen silver print
artworks.creditLine: Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund
artworks.description: This is a photograph of an interior space featuring Gothic architecture. The room has large stained glass windows, stone walls and floors, tall slender columns with intricate carvings, and high ribbed vaulted ceilings. Light coming through the windows creates a serene and contemplative atmosphere, revealing the texture of the stone flooring and enhancing the architectural details.

artworks.title: Cour des Lions, Grenade, Alhambra (Court of the Lions, Granada, Alhambra)
artworks.medium: albumen silver print
artworks.creditLine: Edward J. Lenkin Fund
artworks.description: The image shows the Court of the Lions in the Alhambra, Granada. The view is from inside a shaded colonnade looking towards the courtyard. Columns separate the view, and the Lion Fountain is in the center. The courtyard features intricate columns and arches in a black and white photograph with high contrast, emphasizing light and shadow. The composition showcases the elegance and symmetry of the Moorish design elements.

artworks.title: Bardolph
artworks.medium: etching printed in brown-black  ink on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Vogler in memory of his brother Donald J. Vogler
artworks.description: The image depicts an illustration of a person from the chest up, seen in profile facing to the right. The individual appears to be holding a tankard or a similar object in their right hand. Their notable features include a prominent nose, forehead, eyebrows, deep-set eyes, curly or wavy hair, and a fabric turban or headwrap. The person is wearing a robe with broad lapels and detailed stitching. The background is a simple oval shape with the name "BARDOLPH" above the figure and a quote below.

artworks.title: Cosmo Monkhouse
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Vogler in memory of his brother Donald J. Vogler
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed drawing of a seated man facing left. The man has a stern expression, with distinct facial features including a prominent forehead, deep-set eyes, a bushy beard and mustache, and unruly curly hair. He is wearing formal attire comprising a light-colored suit jacket, a vest, a shirt, and a tie. The background is a plain surface with subtle shading to give depth to the image.

artworks.title: Three Pairs of Beggars with Babies
artworks.medium: red chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ivan E. and Winifred Phillips in honor of Jonathan Bober
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of four figures - three standing and one seated. The standing figures each carry a child on their back. The figure on the left is slightly bent forward and holds a walking stick, wearing a hat or cloth over their head. The middle figure stands upright, holding a child in front and another on their back. The figure on the right is older with a long beard, holding a walking stick and carrying a child. The seated figure faces the standing group, holding a child, and wearing layered clothing. The background is plain, with the figures drawn in a reddish-brown tone on a light cream-colored paper.

artworks.title: View of the Port of Amsterdam with the Office of the Water Authority (Title Page)
artworks.medium: etching with drypoint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: The J. and H. Weldon Foundation Inc. and Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a scene from an elevated platform overlooking a busy waterfront. In the foreground, a street is bustling with people near a large building with ornate architecture. Several ships are docked by the water, with masts and sails visible. In the background, there are more ships on the water and a distant horizon. The etching features intricate line work and a monochromatic color palette of gray and sepia, giving it a historical feel.

artworks.title: The Montalbans Tower in Amsterdam
artworks.medium: etching with drypoint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: The J. and H. Weldon Foundation Inc. and Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund
artworks.description: The image features a bustling harbor scene depicted through an engraving technique. The horizon divides the water and a row of buildings and ships with tall masts. The dock is filled with small figures, likely people, and boats. A tower on the left adds vertical emphasis to the urban landscape. The detailed linework depicts trees, architecture, and water. The overall monochromatic color palette highlights the contrast between elements. Boats' masts form patterns against a sky with wispy clouds.

artworks.title: A Seaport
artworks.medium: etching with drypoint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: The J. and H. Weldon Foundation Inc. and Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a maritime setting with ships sailing on the water. The scene is viewed from a slightly elevated perspective, with delicate and finely detailed brushstrokes depicting boats, figures, and water movement. The color palette is primarily shades of gray and black. Various boats are seen on the water, with a large flag featuring text. More ships with raised sails are moored or sailing in the distance, with marine equipment and structures visible along the shore. The background includes additional boats and a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Sappho
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray, pink, and green wash on laid paper, laid down
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: The image displays a seated person on a green terrain. The person is facing the viewer, sitting in a relaxed posture with closed eyes and a calm expression. They are holding a leafy wreath and wearing a long robe. Surrounding them is ornate text, with additional script in a scroll near their head.

artworks.title: ΦΑΙΝΟΜΑΙ ΑΠΝΟΥΣ (I Seem to Be Breathless)
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint printed in brown and gray on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: William B. O'Neal Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a person reclining on a sloped surface. They are in a lounging posture, leaning back on their left arm and holding a lyre with their right arm raised and bent at the elbow. The person has delicate features, long curly hair, and is dressed in a classical-style robe. The background includes a tree, hills, and trees with a partly cloudy sky.

artworks.title: The "Vergulde Dolphyn," a Large Merchant Vessel, and the "Kat," a Flute
artworks.medium: etching with drypoint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: The J. and H. Weldon Foundation Inc. and Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund
artworks.description: The image displays a maritime scene with two large sailing ships on calm waters. The horizon is low, with other distant ships in the background. The sky has soft clouds, indicating clear weather. The brushstrokes are fine and detailed, focusing on the ships' features. The color scheme is monochromatic with shades of gray and black. The ships are detailed with rigging and flags, while the distant sea features more ships.
